LOW.rationale: no rate changes detected in the last 7 days

NORMAL.rationale: 1 rate change(s) across 1 bank(s) in 7 days sits in the NORMAL band

ELEVATED.rationale: 4 rate changes across 2 banks in 7 days meets the ELEVATED band (>= 4 changes, >= 2 banks)

HIGH.rationale: 8 rate changes across 4 banks in 7 days meets the HIGH band (>= 8 changes, >= 4 banks)
